name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: Build polished AI-assisted presentations that don't look like they were made by a robot.
problem: Most AI presentation tools produce generic, template-heavy slides that undermine credibility and brand identity. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the tension between AI speed and design quality, giving teams a faster workflow without sacrificing visual authenticity. It targets professionals who need compelling decks quickly but can't afford the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
useCases: Creating investor pitch decks with a distinctive visual identity
Building client-facing proposals and strategy presentations
Producing internal team updates and quarterly business reviews
Designing product launch and marketing narrative decks
